title: dbt deps - The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process: 'dbt_packages\\dbt-expectations-0.5.1\\integration_tests'
answer:
In my case and looks like for most of the users, it seems a case of VS Code extensions such as dbt-power-user which interferes with the installation of dbt deps.

A quick workaround is to not use the vscode integrated terminal but close vscode completely and use a standalone terminal just for dbt deps
